planar_cms.issuesDetected: Config Issues Detected with Planar Tools
planar_cms.config.title: Planar Tools Config
planar_cms.config.invalidGlobalDefaultRe: Global Default Resistance must be an integer
planar_cms.config.tooltip.defaultWailaPo: Sets where the Planar Tools WAILA appears when Jade is not present.
planar_cms.config.tooltip.preset: Selects which preset folder under config/planar_cms/presets is loaded for tool, block, and enchantment rules.
planar_cms.config.tooltip.enableAdvanced: Allows the Advanced WAILA keybind, initially Left Shift. The keybind has no effect while Advanced WAILA is enabled in Display settings. Rebind it in Minecraft Controls.
planar_cms.config.tooltip.advancedWailaK: Hold shows Advanced WAILA while pressed. Toggle switches it locally on each press; reloading clears the toggle without saving it.
planar_cms.config.tooltip.showUnconfigur: When enabled, the WAILA still appears for blocks that do not have custom Planar Tools block properties.
planar_cms.config.tooltip.showBlockName: Shows the targeted block name in the default WAILA.
planar_cms.config.tooltip.showModName: Shows the targeted block's Mod in the default WAILA.
planar_cms.config.tooltip.advancedWaila: Always shows Advanced WAILA and ignores its keybind. Includes power tiers when no matching tool type is held.
planar_cms.config.tooltip.showHardness: Shows the block hardness value used by Minecraft's mining speed calculations.
planar_cms.config.tooltip.showExplosionR: Shows the configured explosion resistance override when one exists for the targeted block.
planar_cms.config.tooltip.showDefaultRes: Shows the fallback resistance value used when a tool type does not define a specific requirement.
planar_cms.config.tooltip.showDrops: Shows whether the targeted block is configured to drop normally, drop conditionally, or not drop.
planar_cms.config.tooltip.showToolRequir: Shows the tool type and power requirements configured for mining the targeted block.
planar_cms.config.tooltip.showHeldToolPo: Shows the configured power values for the item currently held in your hand.
planar_cms.config.tooltip.showMiningSpee: Shows mining speed behavior and block-local speed bonuses. Advanced mode shows configured properties for each tool type.
planar_cms.config.tooltip.showUnmineable: Shows when the targeted block is configured as unmineable by Planar Tools rules.
